---
name: AccreditationOS vendoring
description: How to vendor an upgraded AccreditationOS .tsx the user hands over into the Muhakkim app.
---

The user periodically hands a fresh, regenerated `.tsx` of the AccreditationOS tool (نظام الدراسة الذاتية / "Mohakam AI Accreditation OS"). It is the SAME tool upgraded (same storage key `mohakam_data`, same host slot `accreditation_os`), not a new tool — so replace `artifacts/muhakkim/src/AccreditationOS.jsx` in place.

**Why:** their canonical source lives outside the repo and is regenerated by an external AI tool, so each handoff ships in raw "preview" form and silently drops any in-repo edits we made last time.

**How to apply — mandatory patches every handoff (the file will NOT work in Muhakkim without them):**
1. `storeGet/storeSet`: `window.storage.get/set` → `localStorage.getItem/setItem` (window.storage is Replit-preview-only, absent in real browser/deploy).
2. `callAI`: direct `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages` → `AI_ENDPOINT = (import.meta.env.BASE_URL||"/")+"api/ai"`; pass `system` separately (not merged into content), `if(!res.ok)throw`. Never browser→Anthropic.
3. Export contract: incoming file is `export default function App()`; host imports `{ AccreditationOS }`, so rename to `export function AccreditationOS()`.

**Re-apply the «دليل المتطلب» (per-criterion AI guide) feature** — it is an explicit prior deliverable the fresh handoff omits: `guides` state + load/save under `mohakam_data` + props to `Standards({...,guides,setGuides})` + BookOpen button/panel per criterion. Tell the user it was preserved so they can fold it into their source or ask to drop it.

After: `pnpm --filter @workspace/muhakkim run typecheck`, restart `artifacts/muhakkim: web`, grep the file to confirm zero residual `window.storage` / `api.anthropic.com` / `export default`.
